title: CardFlow Gift Card Activation Lifecycle Dataset
scope: An issuer-neutral editorial model that separates purchase, activation, redemption, balance reporting and transaction approval. It does not determine the status of any individual gift card.
privacyBoundary: The dataset never accepts, stores or processes card numbers, PINs, claim codes, receipts or account credentials.

states.label: Purchased
states.definition: A retailer or order record indicates that a product was paid for.
states.safetyNote: Redact unrelated personal details and keep all redeemable credentials private.

states.label: Activated
states.definition: The relevant system accepted an instruction to enable the card or code; the exact mechanism varies by product and sales channel.
canSupport: A transaction may be traceable by the retailer or issuer
states.safetyNote: Use the retailer or issuer named by the product; do not ask a stranger to test a credential.

states.label: Redeemed
states.definition: A later value-use event was recorded, either into an account or directly with a merchant, depending on the product.
canSupport: The destination account or merchant may hold relevant history
cannotProve: What value remains in another system
states.safetyNote: Never publish or forward an unused code to obtain an informal redemption test.

states.label: Balance shown
states.checkpoint: What value did the issuer report at a specific time?
states.definition: An official issuer channel reported a time-specific value.
canSupport: Issuer-reported value at the check time
A more recent status than a purchase or activation record
states.safetyNote: Check only through the issuer's official channel and keep the credential hidden.

states.label: Transaction approved
states.definition: A specific purchase was accepted under one set of merchant, balance and authorization conditions.
canSupport: The merchant and issuer completed one authorization path
states.safetyNote: Share only the minimum transaction context required by official support.

sources.title: If you can't redeem your Apple Gift Card, App Store Card or App Store & iTunes Gift Card
sources.supports: Distinguishes invalid, already-redeemed, not-activated and country or region messages, and directs a not-activated case back to the retailer.

sources.title: Buy, send and receive gifted gift cards on Google Play
sources.supports: Warns users not to share redemption codes and describes issuer-specific balance and redemption support paths.

sources.title: Prepaid gift card frequently asked questions
sources.supports: Provides network-level context that activation paths vary and product-specific questions belong with the issuer or card support channel.

sources.title: 12 CFR 1005.20 — Requirements for gift cards and gift certificates
sources.supports: Provides U.S. regulatory definitions for covered gift certificates, store gift cards and related cards, codes or devices.
